def eligible(items, selected_price, threshold):
    def merge_sort(a):
        if len(a)<2: return a[:]
        m=len(a)//2; l=merge_sort(a[:m]); r=merge_sort(a[m:]); out=[];i=j=0
        while i<len(l) and j<len(r):
            if (l[i][1],l[i][0]) <= (r[j][1],r[j][0]): out.append(l[i]);i+=1
            else: out.append(r[j]);j+=1
        return out+l[i:]+r[j:]
    a=merge_sort(items);lo=0;hi=len(a)
    while lo<hi:
        mid=(lo+hi)//2
        if a[mid][1]+selected_price < threshold:lo=mid+1
        else:hi=mid
    return a[lo:]

steps.text: Check whether the length of a is less than 2. Return a[:].
Set m to len(a) // 2. Set l to merge_sort(a[:m]). Set r to merge_sort(a[m:]). Set out to an empty list. Set i = j to 0.
Repeat while i is less than the length of l and j is less than the length of r.
Check whether (l[i][1], l[i][0]) is at most (r[j][1], r[j][0]). Append l[i] to out. Increase i by 1.
Append r[j] to out. Increase j by 1.
Set a to merge_sort(items). Set lo to 0. Set hi to the length of a.
Repeat while lo is less than hi.
Check whether a[mid][1] + selected_price is less than threshold. Set lo to mid + 1.
